sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Sandy San are straightforward yet engaging. Players use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to draw a path for the sand particles to follow, with the goal of filling all the cups on the screen. The game's physics engine adds a layer of realism, taking into account factors like gravity, friction, and sand particle behavior. This means that players need to plan their moves carefully, considering how the sand will flow and behave as they draw their paths.

The game features a range of sand particles, each with its unique characteristics. Some particles are larger and heavier, while others are smaller and lighter. This adds an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay, as players need to consider how each type of particle will behave in different situations.
